task:
FIX FOUR CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #816 (F2d PR4b), review round 2. Update only the existing branch f2d/pr4b-probe-publish; its head must be 0ac3dd8295f37465c9381caac9dcb20387f4a089 (full SHA from git rev-parse of origin/f2d/pr4b-probe-publish; if it differs, stop and report the SHA you found). Read CLAUDE.md and design sections 8.1, 8.3, 8.6 and 8.7 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md first. All four findings are confirmed; fix each with a test that fails on the current code.

F1 (P1) scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh around line 355, the behavioural probe pairs: today only status codes are checked, so a 503 caused by an unrelated runtime/database failure passes and the one-way publication proceeds while the Finder is unhealthy. Require, for BOTH 503 responses, the exact READY-but-unpublished not-ready detail, exactly as scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py f2d_behavioural_probes() does (around lines 1390-1421: it parses the JSON body and requires parsed.get("detail") == the expected not-ready text). Reuse the same expected detail string (do not invent a new one; find where the API defines it, e.g. apps/api/src routers/archetype or local search not-ready detail, and where f2d_behavioural_probes gets expected_not_ready). Record the parsed detail and a reason_verified flag per pair in the receipt; any mismatch refuses with exit 74 before any write. Bound the response body read.

F2 (P1) scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py around line 2030 (and the matching promote-path call): when select_f2d_rollback returns source authenticated_candidate, the code immediately calls verify_image() on the candidate's images, which runs a local `docker image inspect`; on the first F2d deployment those digests are normally only in the registry (preflight never pulls; promote pulls much later), so preflight and promote still always refuse. Fix: when the rollback source is authenticated_candidate, do NOT verify its images at this point (they are the deployment candidate's own images, which the promote path already pulls and verifies before cutover); keep verify_image for recorded_artifact sources exactly as now. Record in the receipt that the candidate's images are verified by the candidate pull/verify step. Tests: authenticated_candidate source with images absent locally passes the rollback requirement in both preflight and promote; recorded_artifact still calls verify_image.

F3 (P1) scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh around line 123 (api_database_url): it accepts any PostgreSQL URI from the active API container, so a recreated container with a drifted DATABASE_URL would run the irreversible publication against the wrong database. Parse the DSN (python3.14 urllib.parse, never print it) and refuse with a distinct exit code (choose an unused one, e.g. 79, and add it to the action's documented codes and tests) unless its database name equals DATABASE_NAME="edfinder_v3_phase4c_full_20260827_r5", its user equals DATABASE_USER="edfinder_v3", and its host resolves to the pinned PostgreSQL container on WORKER_NETWORK (compare the DSN host with the container name or the container's IP on that network from docker inspect; name the rule you chose). Also, inside scripts/v3_publish_derived_products.py, after connecting and before any write, check current_database() and current_user equal those values (refuse exit 79, no write). Never log or receipt the DSN or password.

F4 (P2) scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py around line 803: the plan probe does not refuse loaded repository modules outside deploy/v3-production/f2d-operator-code.txt (design 8.3 requires it; the publisher and the complete read already do). Add the same refuse_unlisted_checkout_modules() check (copy the implementation from scripts/v3_publish_derived_products.py line ~38, do not import across scripts) and call it before opening the database connection. Test: a probe run that has loaded an unlisted checkout module refuses before connecting.

ALLOWED FILES: scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh; scripts/v3_publish_derived_products.py; scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py; scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py; tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products.py; tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products_operator.py; tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe.py; tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe_operator.py; tests/test_v3_release_gate_f2d.py; CHANGES.md (amend the existing PR4b entry). Nothing else. Do not change the operator-code manifest list (these files are already listed).

VALIDATION TO RUN AND REPORT WITH EXACT COUNTS: bash -n on the action; ruff check scripts tests; python -m pytest tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products.py tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products_operator.py tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe.py tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe_operator.py tests/test_v3_release_gate_f2d.py tests/test_v3_production_application_deployment.py tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py -q -p no:warnings; both identity helpers' compute output (equal); validate_authority on deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json (expect []). Code only; no deploy, no production access. End with: files changed; tests with counts; the DSN host rule you chose for F3; anything you could not do.
